placements.title: Remember's async job contract: dispatch immediately, track via polling, never block
placements.theme: remember always dispatches and returns a receipt immediately; the actual extraction work is tracked asynchronously via polling (or piggybacked reaction), so the caller is never blocked and no work is lost if the receipt is dropped.
placements.why: src-1 states the ratified contract directly (receipt in seconds, polling a cursor, no blocking call, no lost work on dropped receipt) and src-2 restates the same decision in dispatch-then-poll/piggyback vocabulary — both are one directional read of the same standing mechanics, matching the AsyncJobDispatchPollContract position from pass-4. No existing narrative leaf or strata (graph is empty) covers this theme, so it is minted fresh under the newly-minted Architecture strata as the closest organizational home for a system design contract.
